G3-01.ko: 작은 물방울 쏘아 톡 · 떨리는 물막이 흔들림
G3-01.atk: a shy tremble of a glass-bowl hum, one small bead of water flicks off a fingertip with a tiny plip, then a faint wavering splash against the target
G3-01.def: a thin quivering water film wobbles around her: a soft wet slap, a fragile glassy shimmer that trembles and settles, a few small drips

G3-02.atk: a tiny droplet springs up with a bright plink, arcs through the air with a quick whistle, and bursts into a crisp little spatter on impact
G3-02.def: it has no armour: the soft bubbly body pops with a wet pop, a few droplets scatter and pitter, then re-gather with a faint gurgle

G3-03.ko: 꼬리 물장구 찰박 · 몸 굴려 피함
G3-03.atk: a quick flick of a small tail fin, a light slapping splash of kicked water, then a bright little smack as the shiny pebble in his mouth clicks against the foe
G3-03.def: he darts sideways instead of blocking: a squeaky wet flip, a fast ripple, scales brushing a rock with a glancing scrape and a soft flinch of bubbles

G3-04.ko: 조개껍데기 부딪혀 탁 · 껍데기가 딱 막음
G3-04.atk: a heavy shell on its back clacks as it lurches forward, a damp shuffling stomp, then a blunt shoulder bump with a hollow clonk and a dribble of water
G3-04.def: the big clam shell snaps up and takes the hit: a hard chalky clack, a short hollow rattle inside the shell, then wet sand sifting down

G3-06.ko: 물결 타고 미끄러져 휙 · 잔물결로 흘림
G3-06.atk: a smooth gliding hiss rides a rolling swell, a rapid splash-skip across the surface like a flat stone, then a light cuff of water against the foe
G3-06.def: the body dissolves into rippling water: a gentle liquid slosh, the blow slides through with a soft glassy trickle, then it reforms with a quiet lap

G3-07.ko: 작살 던져 쉭 푹 · 작살대로 막아 땡
G3-07.atk: a harpoon shaft is drawn with a wet creak, it hurls with a sharp underwater whoosh trailing bubbles, then sinks into the target with a short thunk and a coral rattle
G3-07.def: he angles the harpoon shaft across his body: a dull wooden clack, a metal barb scraping with a thin ring, bubbles streaming off the haft

G3-08.ko: 물결 휘돌려 철썩 · 물결 장막 흘림
G3-08.atk: a slow swirl of hand-stirred water gathers with a soft gurgle, a smooth rolling swell curls forward, then folds over the foe with a rushing wash and fading ripples
G3-08.def: a gentle wave rises to meet the strike: a deep soft whoosh, the blow sinks into the water with a muffled plop, a healing shimmer of small ripples closing over

G3-09.ko: 차가운 창 찔러 슉 · 창대로 쳐내 챙
G3-09.atk: a cold spear dripping with water is thrust with a crisp whistle, the tip stabs home with a sharp tick, then droplets fall from the blade in a short pattering run
G3-09.def: he turns the spear shaft and a wet leather buckler: a ringing clink of the steel head, a dull slap of the shield, boots grinding on wet stone bridge

G3-10.atk: a clear dew bead trickles down a blade of grass with a delicate tick, then sprays outward in a cool fine mist that hisses lightly against the foe
G3-10.def: it vanishes in a puff of morning mist: a soft airy sigh, a faint damp whisper, and a few leftover droplets dripping from grass leaves

G3-11.ko: 조수 물그릇 흔들어 촤 · 물의 막이 일렁임
G3-11.atk: shallow water in a stone basin sloshes, a ripple of tide rushes up in a rising hiss, then a sharp surging crest crashes against the target in a heavy spray
G3-11.def: a mist of seawater thickens in front of her: a soft hissing veil, the hit thuds into it with a damp muffle, tiny shells tinkling as they settle

G3-12.ko: 산호 방패로 밀어 쿵 · 산호가 딱딱 막음
G3-12.atk: he rams a branching coral shield forward: a gritty scraping lunge, a dense stony bump, then brittle twigs of coral cracking and dropping with a light rattle
G3-12.def: the living coral takes the blow with a hard knocking crack, a dry brittle clatter of broken branches, then a soft wet creak as it settles solid

G3-14.ko: 밀물처럼 밀려와 쏴 · 썰물처럼 빠져 흘림
G3-14.atk: a long surging rush builds like an incoming tide, rolls up the shore with hissing foam, then breaks on the foe with a hard slap and sucks back with a drawn-out gravelly drag
G3-14.def: he ebbs back as the strike lands: a hollow draining gurgle, shingle rattling in the receding water, a glancing knock against a wet scale breastplate

G3-15.ko: 물줄기 모양 바꿔 쏴 · 그릇 따라 출렁
G3-15.atk: a thin stream pours with a bubbling trickle, whips into a tight pressurised jet that whistles across the gap, then smacks into the foe with a bright sharp splash
G3-15.def: the stream sloshes into whatever vessel is nearby: a deep glugging pour, the hit sinks in with a heavy plop, water settling in a swelling slow ripple

G3-16.ko: 묵직한 창대로 내리쳐 쿵 · 한 걸음도 안 물러섬
G3-16.atk: a heavy trident-shaft lifts with a wet creak, slams down in a firm sweeping whoosh, then lands with a dense blunt crack and a spatter of seawater
G3-16.def: he plants his feet and braces armour: a solid metallic clang on a scale cuirass, a grinding scrape of boots that do not slide, a short dull rumble

G3-17.ko: 따뜻한 물 끼얹어 졸졸 · 두터운 몸이 푹 받음
G3-17.atk: warm water is scooped with a mellow slosh and poured out in a soft spreading cascade, a gentle gurgling splash, then a calm bubbling wash fizzing against the foe
G3-17.def: her broad soft body absorbs the hit: a deep damp thump like a full waterskin, warm water sloshing inside, then a slow comforting bubbling exhale

G3-18.ko: 물기둥 솟구쳐 쏴 · 물기둥이 두꺼운 벽
G3-18.atk: the sea heaves and a tall column roars upward with a thick rising rumble, hangs for a breath, then collapses in a thundering cascade of crashing water
G3-18.def: a thick pillar of water stands in the way: the blow plunges in with a heavy deep boom and a churning gurgle, foam hissing as the column wobbles upright

G3-19.ko: 석호 물결 한 방향으로 쏴 · 큰 파도로 막음
G3-19.atk: the entire lagoon leans with a vast hush of sliding water, a long sweeping tide wave builds in a smooth swell, then rolls over the foe with a rich washing crash
G3-19.def: a broad calm wave stands up around her: a resonant low hum of deep water, the strike thuds into it and ripples out in a glassy ring-out that fades slowly

G3-24.ko: 꼬리 휘저어 소용돌이 · 물이 감겨 비껴냄
G3-24.atk: a tail stirs the water, a spiralling whirlpool winds up with an accelerating gurgling roar, then sucks the target in with a deep draining swallow and a churning crash
G3-24.def: water spins around her in a ring: the strike is swept sideways with a rushing swirl, a rising whorl of foam hisses, then spins down with a throaty glug

G3-27.ko: 가시 돋은 비늘 부딪혀 쩍 · 가시가 쏘아냄
G3-27.atk: a deep-sea pressure groan rolls up from below, a heavy coral-spined arm sweeps through dark water with a low whoosh, then lands with a thick crunch and a dull bubble burst
G3-27.def: it stands unmoved in the deep current: the blow clanks off thick barnacled plates with a heavy thud, then sea-urchin spines flick out with a prickling rattle and sting

G3-28.ko: 축복의 물 뿌려 촤 · 은은한 물빛 흡수
G3-28.atk: water is flicked from a brimming ewer in a wide scattering arc: a bright rain of drops, a soft swell of blessed water, then a hushed glittering patter across the foe
G3-28.def: a veil of rain falls around her: the strike meets a soft curtain of droplets with a pillowy thud, a pearly chime of one struck shell, and a gentle trickle

G3-29.ko: 형체 바뀌는 물 덩어리 쿵 · 흐르듯 받아냄
G3-29.atk: formless water rears up, bubbling and shifting pitch from bright to deep, then crashes down as a heavy bulk of liquid with a thick slosh and a rolling surge
G3-29.def: its body ripples and reshapes: the hit sinks in with a gloopy thick plunge, the surface flows back with a rich glassy lap, a swelling gurgle of deep water

G3-32.ko: 깊은 해저 울림 그르릉 · 압력 같은 묵직한 막
G3-32.atk: a deep sub-bass pressure groan stirs in the dark, a thick current heaves, then a crushing hydraulic blast of dark water slams down with a booming shockwave and rolling foam
G3-32.def: his massive scaled tail swings round as a wall: a heavy wet whump against thick plates, a creaking of strained pressure, then a low rumbling ring-out in the deep

G3-33.ko: 심해 심장 박동 쿵쿵 · 파문 속에 흩어짐
G3-33.atk: a deep thudding heartbeat of pressure throbs in water, each beat pushes a stronger shockwave, then the last pulse bursts outward in a rolling crush of thumping surf
G3-33.def: the pulse rings through its liquid body: the strike makes a bass throb with concentric hollow ripples, a long slow wobbling hum, then a muffled settling drip

G3-34.ko: 긴 검 내려쳐 쩡 · 비늘 갑옷 쩡 · 가시 되받음
G3-34.atk: a heavy sword is drawn from a wet scabbard with a long scrape, a powerful overhead whoosh follows, then a ringing slash lands with a heavy crack and a burst of seawater
G3-34.def: his dragon-scale plate absorbs the blow with a deep bell-like clang and long ring-out, then spiny scale fins flick out with a sharp rasping rattle against the attacker

G3-36.ko: 샘물이 솟아 퐁퐁 · 맑은 샘이 흘림
G3-36.atk: a clear spring bubbles up with a bright rising burble, overflows in a gentle gushing sheet, then washes over the foe with a calm breaking splash and a long trickle
G3-36.def: a ring of fresh spring water rises as she kneels: the blow lands on it with a soft glassy slosh, a clean pure water chime, droplets pattering back into the pool

G3-41.ko: 물살 타고 돌진 쏴 · 맨몸이 첨벙
G3-41.atk: a fast pressurised rush of water carries her like a rocket, a roaring hissing surge, then she punches clean through the target with a spearing crack and a sheet of spray
G3-41.def: she is lightly built and unprotected: a wet smack against bare scales, a squeaky skid across slick stone, a splashing tumble and a short gasp of bubbles

G3-42.ko: 바다 통째로 쏟아부음 콸콸 · 맨몸으로 휘청
G3-42.atk: the sea is hauled upward with a colossal sucking groan, a mountainous waterfall dumps down in a deafening roar, and wet sand and cracked shields scatter in a crashing rattle
G3-42.def: a frail body with no ward: a feeble splash of a hit, a soft wet thud, a short dripping stumble and a thin trailing trickle of water

SP-G3.ko: 몸이 물로 흘러 쏴 · 칼이 물을 가름
SP-G3.atk: her body flows into one rushing river that swells with a smooth surge, rises into a towering glassy crest with a deep resonant hum, then crashes in a pearly cascade
SP-G3.def: a blade passes through her watery form with a soft cleaving swish and nothing but a ripple, as a shimmering ward hums and a bright coin of light rings out

UN-G3.atk: a spring wells with a hollow resonating bubble, a gentle swell pushes outward, then breaks as a wave that washes away and returns again with a second softer lapping slap
UN-G3.def: the water gives way and flows back: the blow plunges into her with a deep muffled glug, a returning ripple rolls up the pool with a soft echoing lap

UN-G3-7.ko: 소라 울림 공명 · 조개 같은 공명막
UN-G3-7.atk: an eerie low conch-like resonance swells out of deep water and rings in the air, then a sudden hard crack of a snapped steel blade as it is turned back, with chilling bubbles
UN-G3-7.def: a ringing shell-like hum surrounds her, the strike dies against it in a hollow glassy knock, and the lingering resonance wavers with a slow ghostly shimmer

EP-G3-1.ko: 진주 방패 번쩍 · 물결 세워 흘림
EP-G3-1.atk: a pearl shield rings softly as it lifts, a small sharp jet of water snaps from its rim with a whip, then splashes the foe with a bright spatter and a pearly tick
EP-G3-1.def: she raises a smooth pearl shield and a standing wave: the blade skates off with a clean glassy ring, a quick slithering splash, and a sparkling ward shimmer

EP-G3-2.atk: a heavy harpoon whirs and is hurled with a deep whooshing bore of pressure, it pierces through the target with a splitting crack, then returns on the current with a swift whistling slide and a click as caught
EP-G3-2.def: he turns the harpoon haft against the blow with a hard metallic clang, deep-sea armour groaning, and bubbles streaming from the plates in a dense rolling hiss

EP-G3-3.ko: 맹약의 물 일렁여 철썩 · 젖은 가시 되받음
EP-G3-3.atk: an old ritual bowl of water rings once, a heavy dragon-deep wave rises in a long surge, then slams the foe with a booming slap and a sheet of foam
EP-G3-3.def: a bubble-like shield coin shimmers and spins with a bright ring, the blade slides into the water with a soft splash, and sharp coral shards flick back with a pricking spray

PN-G3-C1.ko: 물거울 비추어 찰랑 · 거울 물이 그대로 버팀
PN-G3-C1.atk: a round basin of still water tilts with a smooth lap, a glassy flash of reflected light zings across, then a flat clean slap of water hits the foe
PN-G3-C1.def: the calm mirror surface holds despite the strike: a single glassy tone rings out, ripples spread in perfect rings and settle, and the water simply stays full

PN-G3-C3.atk: a deep trench resonance swells like a vast hollow shell, a slow pulse of pressure pushes forward, then a muted booming wave rolls out and dissolves in a long soft hiss
PN-G3-C3.def: she is hushed and still beneath the blow: a dull heavy thud into thick water, a damped low groan fading into silence, with a few bubbles rising slowly

PN-G3-U2.ko: 거인 맥박에 맞춰 쿵 · 맥박이 버팀
PN-G3-U2.atk: a distant giant pulse thumps up through the sea floor, the water jumps in a taut ripple on each beat, then a compressed burst of pressure drives out with a surging boom
PN-G3-U2.def: each heartbeat steadies her: the hit lands with a hollow pulse-throb, the water around her thuds in time and holds firm, ripples thrumming without breaking

PN-G3-R.ko: 물그릇 들어 첫 칼 흘림 · 그릇이 버팀
PN-G3-R.atk: a great bowl is tilted with a heavy sloshing glug, a thick ribbon of silvery water pours forward, then lands on the foe with a dulling flat splash that drips off slowly
PN-G3-R.def: water in the bowl bulges up to meet the blade: a blunting wet slap, the edge sliding off with a soft slurp, a blessing shimmer, the bowl standing steady with a deep hum

PN-G3-E.ko: 뱀 비늘 갑옷 찔러 쩍 · 비늘 비껴냄 쩡
PN-G3-E.atk: a heavy scaled gauntlet creaks, a lance of serpent-tooth steel slides forward with a long hiss, then punches through with a hard piercing crack and a rasp of scale scraping
PN-G3-E.def: overlapping serpent scales grind and lock: a hard grating clank as the spear skids off, a deep bell-like ring-out, a shimmering ward hum, the knight fixed solid like stone

UP-G3-11.ko: 조수가 돌아섬 쿠르릉 · 안개 장막이 짙어짐
UP-G3-11.atk: the tide stalls with a long suspended hush, then reverses in a thundering inrush that hurls a huge breaking wave, followed by a drumming spray and a drawn-out seething hiss
UP-G3-11.def: a dense seawater fog stands thick and heavy: the strike sinks into it with a deep damp whump, shells and pearls rattle in the current, and the mist closes slowly

UP-G3-12.ko: 산호 방패 셋 쿵 · 겹겹이 딱딱함
UP-G3-12.atk: three layered coral shields grind together and drive forward in a massive stony shove, a low gritty rumble, then a crushing crack that showers brittle fragments
UP-G3-12.def: stacked coral plates take the hit in sequence: a deep knocking crack, a second duller clack, a third solid thud, then a cascade of tiny coral chips and a settling creak

UP-G3-17.ko: 물 한 줌 떠 세 번 씻음 · 두터운 물몸
UP-G3-17.atk: a cupped handful of warm water is lifted, then released in three soft cascading washes, each with a deeper gurgle, finishing with a mellow rolling splash and a lingering sparkle
UP-G3-17.def: her huge soft body takes the blow like a deep warm pool: a thick low thump, water swelling and sloshing up around her in slow ripples, and a calm bubbling sigh

UP-G3-18.ko: 세 물기둥 나란히 세움 · 성벽 같은 물
UP-G3-18.atk: three water columns erupt one after another with rising pitch and align with a clean rushing hiss, then fall together in one massive unified crash like a collapsing sea wall
UP-G3-18.def: three columns merge into a smooth towering wall: the hit slams it with a heavy booming thud, the whole wall shudders with a deep wobbling slosh, then stands firm

UP-G3-24.ko: 소용돌이 속 춤 · 발끝 물살 비킴
UP-G3-24.atk: light footfalls tap on the water's surface inside a roaring whirlpool, the spiral accelerates into a high-speed vortex, then flings the target outward with a violent sucking crash
UP-G3-24.def: she dances with the swirl: the blow is caught in a spinning wall of water that carries it away in a whooshing circle, foam hissing, with a graceful lap of settling ripples

MC-03.cast: a stream suddenly reverses with a sucking gurgle, a bright surge of drawn-back energy whips across the gap, then slams into the foremost enemies with a double splashing slap

MC-04.cast: knees touch wet sand, water steadily rises and laps with a soft swelling gurgle, a warm glassy shimmer settles over the front line, and tiny ripples fade into calm

MG-03.ko: 샘물 한 모금 꿀꺽 · 몸이 깨어남
MG-03.cast: a cupped hand dips into a spring with a clear plunk, a single refreshing swallow of cool water gulps, then a bright rising shimmer of renewed vitality sparkles up

SG3-01.cast: a wave crashes against rock with a booming slap, white spray explodes upward in a hissing fizz, then a wide mist of droplets patters down on the rear ranks

SG3-02.cast: a quiet brook babbles, then abruptly swells into a thundering rush, a churning whitewater roar sweeps along stones with a rolling rattle and knocks the target over in a heavy splash

SG3-03.cast: a thin sheet of water lifts with a fine rushing whisper, hangs shimmering like glass, a blade slips through it with a swish and dulls, while a soft warm ripple pulses outward

MG-11.cast: a distant deep rumble swells, a towering wall of water roars in, then crashes over the land in a thunderous breaking crash followed by a long draining hiss and gurgle

MG-12.cast: blessed water is sprinkled in a bright tinkling rain, a cool wash rinses over the enemy line with a soft hissing swish while a warm bubbling shimmer wraps around the front ally

MG-15.cast: a warm tide rises with a gentle gliding hush, spreads across the whole field in soft lapping ripples, then ebbs away with a trickling drain and a glow of rising sparkles

SG3-09.ko: 큰 해류 방향 틀어 운 떠내려감
SG3-09.cast: a vast slow current groans and swings round, deep water pulls with a hollow sweeping roar, small shiny coins and shells rattle away on the stream, then it fades to a warm lapping tide

RG3-1.ko: 맥박 한 번 크게, 바다가 삼킴
RG3-1.cast: a single colossal bass heartbeat thumps under the sea, the horizon draws back with a huge sucking hiss, then a mountainous wave smashes everything in a deafening crash, leaving a soft calming ripple

NG3-1.cast: the sea roughens with a rising choppy roar, big waves heave one after another with heavy slapping crashes, and foam surges across the land in a long hissing rush

NG3-2.ko: 물살 거꾸로 흘러 뒤 적 밀려나옴
NG3-2.cast: water suddenly reverses with a sucking drag, wet bodies skid over gravel with a rattling shuffle, a hidden foe is shoved forward, then a hard wave smacks it with a thick splash

US-G3-1.cast: a pure ringing tone of water echoes in a deep vessel, a cool translucent wave rolls across the enemy line stripping ornaments with a rinsing hiss and glassy rattle, then a warm calming swell lingers

US-G3-2.cast: water drains away with a long hollow slurp, a deep distant throb, then the sea rushes back in a heaving swell that sweeps the enemy with a crash and gently washes the allies in warm lapping ripples

PS-G3-1.cast: a still pond surface hums with a glassy tone, a flash of reflection flips with a quick liquid twist, and a pair of sounds, one sharp and one heavy, swap places with a soft splash

PS-G3-2.cast: water drains away with a long draining gurgle, shingle rattles back down the beach, a heavy wave energy deflates with a sighing hiss, and everything goes slack and quiet

RS-G3-1.ko: 작살이 물살 타고 방패도 씻고 박힘
RS-G3-1.cast: a harpoon whistles along a rushing stream, rinsing away a shield with a washing hiss, then bites into the foe with a deep sharp thunk and a draining trickle

RS-G3-2.cast: a mass of soap-like sea foam bubbles up and wraps the front ally with a fizzy crackle, a blade skids on it with a squeak, tiny droplets patter, and warm bubbles close wounds with soft pops

RS-G3-3.ko: 차오르는 밀물이 적 운 쓸고 아군 적심
RS-G3-3.cast: a rising tide gurgles in, a deep hollow conch tone rings and holds, a wave sweeps the enemy with a rushing wash, and warm water laps gently around the allied feet

CS-G3.cast: a half-formed spell crackles, a clean cold wave douses it with a hissing snuff, then rinses over the front unit with a washing rush stripping its wards with a glassy chiming rattle

IG3-1.equip: a polished seashell on a cord is looped over a neck with a soft slither, clicks against another shell with a dry clack, and gives a faint ocean-like hush when held

IG3-2.equip: a stoppered flask is uncorked with a soft pop, clear water glugs and trickles into a hand, and the cork taps back in with a light knock and a warm shimmer

IG3-3.equip: a red coral dagger slides into a belt sheath with a dry gritty scrape, a brittle tick of coral, and one quick test flick that whistles with a curving swish like a throw

IG3-4.equip: a pearl-studded emblem is pinned to a chest with a small metal click, the pearls roll with a soft glassy rattle, and one finger tap rings with a clear tiny tone

IG3-5.equip: a glass orb holding one drop is lifted with a delicate glass tick, the drop inside swirls with a tiny sloshing wobble, and a thin watery whine hums when it is squeezed

IG3-6.equip: a single iridescent scale is pressed onto armour with a wet sticky squeak, then a thin glassy chime shimmers as it settles, and a blade tapped on it skids with a slick slither

IG3-7.equip: a heavy silver chalice is set down with a solid clink, water fills it with a bubbling gurgle, then brims over and runs down its sides in a warm trickling stream

IG3-8.equip: a long trident is gripped with a leathery creak, its three prongs click against each other, and a swell and drain of water hisses along the shaft like a tide coming and going

IR-G3.equip: one large luminous drop falls with a deep clear plunk, spreads in a widening glassy ripple around the bearer, and a warm cleansing wash trickles away in a gentle shimmer

PI-G3.ko: 용의 비늘 한 장 단단히 붙음
PI-G3.equip: a huge dragon scale is slid onto the chest with a heavy metallic scrape, locks in place with a deep thud, rings with a long resonant tone, and a cool misty shimmer hums around it

TK-G3-1.ko: 작은 물살 쏴 · 물로 흩어져 흘림
TK-G3-1.atk: a small sprite of water gathers with a bubbling burble, bounds forward with a quick skipping splash, then smacks the foe in a bright slap and a short spray of drops
TK-G3-1.def: it simply sloshes apart on contact: a soft liquid gloop, the blow passing through with a wet swish, and the pieces trickling back together with a gentle lapping
